title: Crop Insurance Requirement Schedule for Operating Lines of Credit
content:
Three of the Operating Lines of Credit require the financed crops to be insured, with the indemnity assigned to the association, at no less than a set coverage level.

## Terms

- **Crop insurance required**: whether a multi-peril crop insurance policy on the financed crops must be in force with the indemnity assigned to the association.
- **Minimum coverage level**: the lowest crop insurance coverage level that satisfies the insurance requirement, in percent; 0 means there is no requirement.

## Schedule

| Product | Crop insurance required | Minimum coverage level (%) |
|---|---|---|
| StartRight Operating Line | Yes | 70 |
| ExpressLine Operating Credit | No | 0 (no requirement) |
| Seasonal Operating Loan | Yes | 70 |
| Revolving Operating Line | No | 0 (no requirement) |
| Borrowing Base Operating Line | Yes | 65 |
| Agribusiness Revolving Line | No | 0 (no requirement) |

## Points of reading

- A policy at exactly the minimum coverage level satisfies the requirement; one below it does not.
- *Hypothetical illustration:* a policy at 65% coverage meets the Borrowing Base Operating Line minimum but not the 70% minimum of the StartRight Operating Line or the Seasonal Operating Loan.
